items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1994-01-15
items.q: But Art Roup managed to finesse Joe out of all that.

ctx.x: Right. To get A1. And literally owned it legally. Mm-hmm. And they had some paperwork that said that this portion of it is Joe Banaszak's and this other portion of it he can buy and all that. But Art Roup managed to finesse Joe out of all that. Mm-hmm. And that was the one thing. The other major disappointment he had was, of course, that... That... He lost Alan Toussaint.
